description: Curated catalog of email-sending services. Used by the engine to label DMARC source IPs and by the dashboard to drive the Authorization Wizard. Matching priority: rdns patterns > orgKeywords (case-insensitive substring on the rDNS PTR + GeoOrg fields).

services.name: Microsoft 365
services.authInstructions: Microsoft 365 Defender > Email & collaboration > Email authentication > DKIM > select domain > rotate/enable DKIM keys; add the two CNAMEs shown to your DNS.

services.name: Google Workspace
services.dkimCnameTemplate: google._domainkey.{your-domain} TXT (generated in Admin Console > Apps > Google Workspace > Gmail > Authenticate email)
services.authInstructions: Admin Console > Apps > Google Workspace > Gmail > Authenticate email > Generate new record (2048-bit) > add the TXT to DNS > Start authentication.

services.name: Google SMTP Relay
services.authInstructions: Configure the SMTP relay service in Google Admin; ensure your sending IP is allow-listed and SPF includes _spf.google.com.

services.name: Amazon SES
services.authInstructions: SES console > Verified identities > select your domain > DKIM > publish the three CNAMEs. Production access required to send outside the sandbox.

services.name: SendGrid
services.authInstructions: SendGrid > Settings > Sender Authentication > Authenticate Your Domain > select DNS host > follow wizard, publish 3 CNAMEs.

services.name: Mailgun
services.dkimCnameTemplate: smtp._domainkey.{your-domain} TXT (provided in Mailgun control panel)
services.authInstructions: Mailgun > Sending > Domains > Add domain > publish the TXT (SPF) + TXT (DKIM) + CNAME (tracking).

services.name: Mailchimp
services.authInstructions: Mailchimp > Website > Domains > Verify domain > add the CNAME shown for k1._domainkey.

services.name: Mandrill
services.dkimCnameTemplate: mandrill._domainkey.{your-domain} TXT (provided in Mandrill SMTP & API > Domains)
services.authInstructions: Mandrill > Settings > Sending domains > add domain > publish provided TXT records for SPF and DKIM.

services.name: Postmark
services.authInstructions: Postmark > Sender Signatures > Add Domain > publish the Return-Path CNAME, DKIM TXT, and SPF include.

services.name: SparkPost
services.authInstructions: SparkPost > Account > Sending Domains > add domain > publish CNAME + TXT records shown.

services.name: Brevo (Sendinblue)
services.dkimCnameTemplate: mail._domainkey.{your-domain} TXT (Brevo > Senders, domains & dedicated IPs > Domains)
services.authInstructions: Brevo > Senders > Domains > Add domain > publish the SPF TXT + DKIM TXT + DMARC TXT shown.

services.name: SocketLabs
services.authInstructions: SocketLabs > Settings > Domain Management > add domain > publish CNAME and DKIM records.

services.name: Mailjet
services.authInstructions: Mailjet > Account > Senders & Domains > add domain > publish the SPF and DKIM records shown.

services.name: Elastic Email
services.authInstructions: Elastic Email > Settings > Sending domains > add and verify; publish CNAME and TXT shown.

services.name: SMTP2GO
services.authInstructions: SMTP2GO > Settings > Sender Domains > add your domain > publish the listed CNAMEs.

services.name: Resend
services.authInstructions: Resend > Domains > Add domain > publish SPF TXT (include:amazonses.com), DKIM TXT, and DMARC TXT.

services.name: Loops
services.authInstructions: Loops > Settings > Email > add sending domain > publish TXT + CNAMEs shown.

services.name: Klaviyo
services.authInstructions: Klaviyo > Account > Settings > Domains and hosting > Get started > publish the CNAMEs shown.

services.name: HubSpot
services.authInstructions: HubSpot > Settings > Marketing > Email > Advanced > Connect a sending domain > publish CNAMEs.

services.name: Marketo
services.authInstructions: Marketo > Admin > Email > Email Branding > Email Deliverability > publish the SPF TXT and DKIM TXT shown.

services.name: Pardot / Account Engagement
services.authInstructions: Pardot > Admin > Domain Management > add Email Sending Domain > publish CNAMEs.

services.name: Salesforce Marketing Cloud
services.authInstructions: Marketing Cloud > Setup > Sender Authentication Package > follow wizard, publish records.

services.name: Salesforce (org-to-user)
services.authInstructions: Setup > Email Administration > DKIM Keys > Create Key > publish the TXT records to DNS, activate the key.

services.name: Constant Contact
services.authInstructions: Account > Self-authentication > publish TXT + CNAMEs.

services.name: ActiveCampaign
services.authInstructions: Settings > Advanced > Domain branding > publish DKIM TXT and CNAME.

services.name: Campaign Monitor
services.authInstructions: Campaign Monitor > Account > Email authentication > publish CNAME records.

services.name: MailerLite
services.authInstructions: Settings > Domain authentication > publish the SPF TXT and DKIM TXT.

services.name: GetResponse
services.authInstructions: Tools > Email authentication > add domain > publish CNAMEs.

services.name: AWeber
services.authInstructions: Account settings > Senders > Update > publish the SPF TXT and DKIM CNAME.

services.name: Iterable
services.authInstructions: Settings > Project settings > Domain authentication > publish CNAMEs.

services.name: Braze
services.authInstructions: Settings > Sending domains > add domain > publish CNAMEs (Braze sits on SparkPost or own infra).

services.name: Customer.io
services.authInstructions: Workspace Settings > Sending behaviors > add Sending Domain > publish CNAMEs.

services.name: Intercom
services.authInstructions: Settings > Channels > Email > Custom email addresses > set sender domain, publish CNAMEs.

services.name: Zendesk
services.authInstructions: Admin Center > Channels > Email > add support address > publish DKIM CNAMEs and SPF include.

services.name: Freshdesk
services.authInstructions: Admin > Email > Support emails > add forwarding email > publish the DKIM TXT records.

services.name: Help Scout
services.authInstructions: Manage > Company > Authentication > publish the CNAMEs and SPF include.

services.name: Drift
services.authInstructions: Settings > App settings > Email > publish DKIM CNAMEs.

services.name: Stripe
services.authInstructions: Stripe Dashboard > Settings > Emails > Custom domain > publish CNAMEs.

services.name: Shopify
services.authInstructions: Shopify admin > Settings > Notifications > Sender email > verify > publish CNAMEs.

services.name: Atlassian (Jira/Confluence)
services.authInstructions: Atlassian Cloud Admin > Email > Custom sender email > publish the TXT records.

services.name: GitHub
services.authInstructions: GitHub Enterprise > Admin > Email > custom from address (not typically configurable on github.com SaaS).

services.name: GitLab
services.authInstructions: Self-hosted GitLab Omnibus: configure outbound SMTP > set sender domain > publish SPF/DKIM.

services.name: Slack
services.authInstructions: Workspace owner only: contact Slack support for custom sender domain (Enterprise Grid).

services.name: Asana
services.authInstructions: Asana does not currently allow custom sender domains; ensure your DMARC permits asana.com or accept their default.

services.name: Notion
services.authInstructions: Notion does not allow custom sender domains; accept their default sender.

services.name: monday.com
services.authInstructions: monday.com does not currently support custom sender domains.

services.name: Linear
services.authInstructions: Linear sends from linear.app; no custom sender.

services.name: Calendly
services.authInstructions: Calendly > Account > Email branding (Teams+ plan) > custom from address > publish CNAMEs.

services.name: DocuSign
services.authInstructions: Admin > Email Configuration > Branding > Custom Email Domain (Enterprise) > publish TXT + CNAMEs.

services.name: Adobe Acrobat Sign
services.authInstructions: Adobe Admin Console > Acrobat Sign > Email settings > Custom domain (Enterprise) > publish records.

services.name: Zoom
services.authInstructions: Zoom Admin > Account Management > Account Settings > Email Notification > Custom sender (Enterprise) > publish records.

services.name: Twilio
services.authInstructions: Twilio SendGrid (see sendgrid). Twilio direct messages do not have custom email DKIM.

services.name: Datadog
services.authInstructions: Datadog sends from datadoghq.com; no custom sender.

services.name: New Relic
services.authInstructions: New Relic sends from newrelic.com; no custom sender.

services.name: PagerDuty
services.authInstructions: PagerDuty sends from pagerduty.com.

services.name: Sentry
services.authInstructions: Sentry sends from sentry.io; no custom sender.

services.name: Opsgenie
services.authInstructions: Opsgenie sends from opsgenie.com; managed by Atlassian.

services.name: Outreach
services.authInstructions: Outreach > Settings > Admin > Email > publish DKIM + SPF entries.

services.name: Salesloft
services.authInstructions: Salesloft uses your connected Gmail/M365 inbox; no separate DKIM.

services.name: Apollo.io
services.authInstructions: Apollo relays through your connected mailbox; uses your domain's auth.

services.name: Lemlist
services.authInstructions: Lemlist sends through your connected mailbox; uses your domain's auth.

services.name: Mailshake
services.authInstructions: Mailshake sends through your connected mailbox; uses your domain's auth.

services.name: Yesware
services.authInstructions: Yesware sends through your connected mailbox.

services.name: Mixmax
services.authInstructions: Mixmax sends through your connected mailbox.

services.name: Proofpoint
services.authInstructions: Proofpoint Essentials/Enterprise > Email Authentication > publish DKIM TXT and SPF include.

services.name: Mimecast
services.authInstructions: Mimecast > Administration > Services > DNS Authentication > publish records.

services.name: Barracuda
services.authInstructions: Barracuda Email Gateway > Account > Domains > publish records.

services.name: Cisco Email Security / IronPort
services.authInstructions: Cisco Email Security Appliance > Mail Policies > Domain Keys > generate and publish DKIM.

services.name: Cloudflare Email Routing
services.authInstructions: Cloudflare Email Routing only handles inbound forwarding; outbound DKIM not applicable.

services.name: Zoho Mail
services.authInstructions: Zoho Mail > Control Panel > Mail Settings > Domains > DKIM > generate keys, publish TXT.

services.name: Zoho Campaigns
services.authInstructions: Zoho Campaigns > Settings > Email Authentication > publish DKIM/SPF.

services.name: Fastmail
services.authInstructions: Fastmail > Settings > Domains > add > publish provided CNAMEs.

services.name: Proton Mail
services.authInstructions: Proton > Settings > Domain Names > add > publish SPF, DKIM, DMARC.

services.name: Yahoo Mail
services.authInstructions: Consumer Yahoo Mail; not a corporate sending service.

services.name: AOL Mail
services.authInstructions: Consumer AOL Mail; not a corporate sending service.

services.name: iCloud Mail
services.authInstructions: Consumer iCloud Mail; not a corporate sending service.
